:::{#me}

## Goals
Currently I am an aspiring PhD student at the University of New Hampshire. My research interests include watershed biogeochemistry, nutrient cycling, nitrogen deposition, and soil biochemistry. I am particularly interested in understanding how environmental changes influence water quality and forested ecosystems.

## Education
M.S. in Environmental and Soil Sciences, University of Tennessee, Knoxville (2025)
B.S. in Environmental and Soil Sciences, University of Tennessee, Knoxville (2023), Summa Cum Laude

## Experience
I previously worked as the Staff Environmental Scientist for the Town of Charlestown, Rhode Island, focusing on water quality and wastewater management.

My academic career covers a wide variety of topics in environmental research, including: GIS and spatial analysis, agricultural fieldwork, laboratory instruction, TA mentorship, and statistical water quaility data analysis. I enjoy combining field observations and computational tools to better understand drivers of environmental processes.
:::
